### Added
- New `PreviewMode` enum (`Default`/`Inline`/`PropertyEditorWindow`) on `SOCItemEditorOptionsAttribute`, plus a matching project-wide default in `SOCSettings` (Project Settings > Scriptable Object Collection > Item Inspector). When set to `PropertyEditorWindow`, the per-field Edit button opens Unity's floating Property Editor via `EditorUtility.OpenPropertyEditor` instead of the inline preview panel — fixes rendering issues with third-party inspectors (e.g. Odin) that don't draw correctly in th
- Fixed method name `SetUsingBaseClassForItems` → `SetUseBaseClassForItems`

## Changed
- Fixed issue with the `TreeView` and the unity version compatibility by @RoyTheunissen https://github.com/brunomikoski/ScriptableObjectCollection/pull/182
- LongGuids are now displayed via their base64 string by @RoyTheunissen https://github.com/brunomikoski/ScriptableObjectCollection/pull/184
- `IndirectReferences` are not generated per item type, so it can filter what type of items can be displayed on the picker
- Fixed issue where renaming one asset on the CollectionE
- Hook: Improve error message when a download from GitHub releases fails.

- Add `CommonDatabase.trace`, reporting statement trace events through a callback registered with `sqlite3_trace_v2`.
- Add `Database.interrupt()` and `Database.isInterrupted` on native platforms.
- IndexedDB file system: Treat unexpected abort events as errors.
- Update SQLCipher to version 4.20.0.

- Fix `InMemoryFileSystem` (and `IndexedDbFileSystem`, which reads through it) copying the rest of the file on every read when compiled with dart2wasm, which made opening a database quadratic in its size.
- Add `RawPreparedStatement.busy`.
- Fix a number of memory safety violations, mostly on the web.

- Update SQLite to 3.54.0.
- Update SQLite3 Multiple Cipher to 2.6.1.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/simolus3/sqlite3.dart/compare/sqlite3-3.7.0...sqlite3-3.7.1

- Update bundled OpenSSL for SQLCipher to 4.0.3.
- Add `RawPreparedStatement.columnBytes` and `RawPreparedStatement.columnBlobInto`, which copies a column into an existing buffer instead of allocating a new list for each value.
- Hooks: `defines` accepts a map with per-OS entries and a `default`, like `source` and `name`.
- Add `CommonDatabase.status()` reporting status counters.
- Add `Database.releaseMemory()` on native platforms.

- Hooks: `source` and `name` accept a map with per-OS entries and a `default` (e.g. `source: {android: system, default: sqlite3}`). Names containing a path (like `foo.framework/foo`) are passed to the loader as-is with `source: system`.
- Fix `IndexedDbFileSystem.flush()` not awaiting an ongoing write transaction.

- Fix `WasmSqlite3.loadFromUrl` silently dropping request headers and a custom WASM loader.
- Fix OPFS atomics VFS causing IO errors for files larger than 2GB.
- Upgrade SQLCipher to 4.18.0.

* SpotBugs reports `DB_DUPLICATE_SWITCH_CLAUSES` (low priority) in the generated `compareTo` of choices with several cases of the same type. It is intended; add `compareTo` to a SpotBugs filter which excludes this pattern for other generated methods.
The goal: faster feedback on changes, and releases with fewer manual steps and so fewer chances for mistakes.
* **Faster feedback:** a pull request now runs a short smoke run, only for the languages its changes can affect, and gets its result in minutes instead
